scope: Fail-closed discrepancy and open-input ledger for only the corrected nonlinear Bell and Bai et al. (2015)/Sun and Bai Section 5.4 shock comparisons.

entries.finding: The retained target-paper Bell benchmark is linear and provides no standalone nonlinear-saturation dataset.
entries.required_resolution: Provide a separately provenance-bound nonlinear reference dataset or limit the claim to a target-paper-normalized nonlinear AthenaK study without direct saturation reproduction.

entries.finding: The corrected Q019 design freezes the normalization and branch boundaries but not exact nonlinear production decks or branch-specific values.
entries.required_resolution: Bind the passed Q043 raw cycle-one oracle, corrected Q023 predecessor, exact Q019 decks, excluded-pilot results, branch parameters, seeds, and preregistration.

entries.finding: AthenaK corrected Q019 is no-Hall; Bai et al. derives and applies a CR-Hall-modified formulation.
entries.required_resolution: Keep Hall-modified growth, saturation, and shock-front claims excluded from this comparison.

entries.finding: Neither retained target-reference PDF supplies a standalone nonlinear Bell comparison tolerance.
entries.required_resolution: Freeze reference-derived or independently justified tolerances before inspecting qualifying nonlinear output.

entries.finding: Sun and Bai Section 5.4 does not explicitly state P0; Q011 p0=1 is selected because Bai et al. explicitly uses P0=T0=1.
entries.required_resolution: Continue labeling p0=1 as a Bai-et-al.-anchored selected baseline, not an explicit Sun-and-Bai Section 5.4 value.

entries.finding: Sun and Bai and Q011 inject at an ideal shock surface, while Bai et al. dynamically identifies the shock and uses a more involved injection and compensation treatment.
entries.required_resolution: Compare Q011 directly to the Sun-and-Bai ideal-surface setup and treat Bai et al. as a related predecessor rather than exact injection-algorithm reproduction.

entries.finding: Q011 matches Sun and Bai eta=1e-3 and domain 48000 by 3120, while Bai's fiducial R2 uses eta=2e-3 and a 1.2e5 by 3000 domain; Q011 is no-Hall.
entries.required_resolution: Keep Bai comparisons parameter-specific and do not label Q011 as an exact Bai R2 or Hall-shock reproduction.

entries.finding: No authorized machine-readable extraction with uncertainty exists for the shock figures or their approximate plotted outcomes.
entries.required_resolution: Extract only under the authorized Orion Q022 dataset root with source locator, method, uncertainty, checksum, redistribution basis, and review.

entries.finding: No reference-derived numeric shock comparison tolerance is frozen. Existing Q011 engineering gates are not Q022 reference tolerances.
entries.required_resolution: Freeze reference-specific tolerances before inspecting qualifying AthenaK comparison output.

entries.finding: External scientific reviewer disposition is pending.
entries.required_resolution: Obtain a disposition that explicitly reviews equations, units, normalization, overlap, exclusions, discrepancies, and any future extracted data and tolerances.
